requirements.quote: While you are at it, clear out `/opt/kestrel` so that directory no longer exists; the host is short on disk space.
Inside that directory generate a verification report named `/home/user/uptime_checks/uptime_checksum_report.log`.
The report **must** use this exact pipe-delimited format (first row is a header):
Columns are separated by a single “|” (pipe) character.
No leading or trailing spaces in any column.
Rows appear in the same order as in `/home/user/monitoring/checksums.sha256`.

check.cmd:
python3 -c 'import hashlib,sys
m=sys.argv[1]; rows=[]
for l in open(m+"/checksums.sha256").read().splitlines():
 if not l.strip(): continue
 h,p=l.split("  ",1); a=hashlib.sha256(open(m+"/"+p,"rb").read()).hexdigest()
 rows.append("|".join([p,h,a,"OK" if h==a else "FAIL"]))
got=open(sys.argv[2]).read().splitlines()
assert got[1:]==rows,(got,rows)
' /home/user/monitoring /home/user/uptime_checks/uptime_checksum_report.log

requirements.quote: Do not alter the original log files or the reference checksum file; your job is only to verify and report.
`Verification complete: 2 OK, 1 FAIL. See /home/user/uptime_checks/uptime_checksum_report.log for details.`
